regions.label: SceneInitializerPointers
regions.evidence: Ten little-endian CPU pointer words between supported indirect-dispatch stub and routine at physical $1C164. Consumer at $1C12E/$1C133 indexes by doubled mode $045B and JSRs through $000E; effective low bank must be selected by caller. This is pointer data, not proof every target naturally executes.

regions.label: NMIPhasePointers
regions.evidence: Eleven little-endian CPU pointer words between supported indirect JMP and code at physical $1C2C2; consumer at $1C29F/$1C2A4 indexes by doubled $045B. Repeated $C468 handler pointers and initial $C2B2. Structural table role only; runtime full selector domain unproven.

regions.label: OrdinalByteGroups
regions.evidence: Repeated small ordinal byte groups bounded by preceding unconditional JMP at $1C1EF and register-save routine at $1C22D. Nearby startup/main and references reviewed; clear non-code pattern. Exact semantic consumer unresolved; generic Data, label describes observed ramp only.
